description: This file contains functions for rendering Excalidraw elements into SVG, including handling different element types, applying transformations, and embedding iframes or images. It also exports a function to render a scene of elements into an SVG root.

methods.name: roughSVGDrawWithPrecision
methods.description: Draws a drawable shape with optional fixed decimal precision using RoughSVG.

methods.name: maybeWrapNodesInFrameClipPath
methods.description: Wraps SVG nodes in a clip path if frame rendering and clipping are enabled.

methods.name: renderElementToSvg
methods.description: Renders a single Excalidraw element into SVG, handling different element types and transformations.

methods.name: renderSceneToSvg
methods.description: Renders a collection of Excalidraw elements into an SVG root element, including handling embedded iframes and images.
